turns.en: I'm going to give you a course of antibiotics. Take one twice a day, morning and evening, and finish the whole course even if you feel better.
turns.cy: Dw i'n mynd i roi cwrs o wrthfiotigau i chi. Cymrwch un ddwywaith y dydd, bore a gyda'r nos, a gorffennwch y cwrs cyfan hyd yn oed os dach chi'n teimlo'n well.
chunks: I'm going to give you a course of antibiotics
Dw i'n mynd i roi cwrs o wrthfiotigau i chi
the recipient i chi lands clause-finally, where English puts it early
Take one twice a day, morning and evening
Cymrwch un ddwywaith y dydd, bore a gyda'r nos
Welsh marks evening with gyda'r nos
and finish the whole course even if you feel better
a gorffennwch y cwrs cyfan hyd yn oed os dach chi'n teimlo'n well

turns.en: Righto. Twice a day, morning and evening. Finish the lot.
turns.cy: Reit-o. Ddwywaith y dydd, bore a gyda'r nos. Gorffen y cwbl.
chunks: Twice a day, morning and evening
Ddwywaith y dydd, bore a gyda'r nos
the patient echoes the instruction, so the imperative becomes a verbal noun — Welsh cannot echo an imperative

turns.en: That's it exactly. Set an alarm on your phone if it helps - breakfast and supper is the easy way to remember.
turns.cy: Dyna fo'n union. Gosodwch larwm ar eich ffôn os ydy o'n helpu — brecwast a swper ydy'r ffordd hawdd o gofio.
chunks: Set an alarm on your phone if it helps
Gosodwch larwm ar eich ffôn os ydy o'n helpu
breakfast and supper is the easy way to remember
brecwast a swper ydy'r ffordd hawdd o gofio
identificatory fronting; 'to remember' becomes the o + verbal noun Welsh needs after ffordd

turns.en: Breakfast and supper. I can manage that.
turns.cy: Brecwast a swper. Mi fedra i ddod i ben efo hynny.
chunks: Mi fedra i ddod i ben efo hynny
the walk's one manage-lexeme, dod i ben

turns.en: The prescription's gone electronically to your chemist - it'll be ready within the hour.
turns.cy: Mae'r presgripsiwn wedi mynd yn electronig at eich fferyllydd chi — mi fydd o'n barod o fewn yr awr.
chunks: The prescription's gone electronically to your chemist
Mae'r presgripsiwn wedi mynd yn electronig at eich fferyllydd chi
motion toward a person takes at, not i (§4)
it'll be ready within the hour
mi fydd o'n barod o fewn yr awr

turns.en: I'll call in on the way home. Thank you, doctor.
turns.cy: Mi alwa i heibio ar y ffordd adra. Diolch, doctor.
chunks: I'll call in on the way home
Mi alwa i heibio ar y ffordd adra
English's 'call in' relocates to galw heibio — the same verb as the summons 'call', but the particle changes its sense entirely

turns.en: A course of antibiotics - one twice a day, and finish the whole course even if you feel better.
turns.cy: Cwrs o wrthfiotigau — un ddwywaith y dydd, a gorffennwch y cwrs cyfan hyd yn oed os dach chi'n teimlo'n well.
chunks: and finish the whole course even if you feel better
a gorffennwch y cwrs cyfan hyd yn oed os dach chi'n teimlo'n well

turns.en: Can I still have a glass of wine with these?
turns.cy: Ga i ddal i gael gwydraid o win efo'r rhain?
chunks: Can I still have a glass of wine with these?
Ga i ddal i gael gwydraid o win efo'r rhain?
the permission ga i; 'still' → dal i, the same frame as 'keep -ing'

turns.en: Best not with these - alcohol can make the side effects worse. One week off won't hurt.
turns.cy: Gwell peidio efo'r rhain — mi fedar alcohol neud y sgil-effeithiau'n waeth. Wneith wythnos i ffwrdd ddim drwg.
chunks: English's elliptical 'best not' needs the Welsh verb peidio under it
alcohol can make the side effects worse
mi fedar alcohol neud y sgil-effeithiau'n waeth
Wneith wythnos i ffwrdd ddim drwg
Welsh has no verb 'to hurt' intransitively here — it says 'won't do harm'

turns.en: A week off the wine. My wife will be delighted.
turns.cy: Wythnos i ffwrdd o'r gwin. Mi fydd fy ngwraig i wrth ei bodd.
chunks: Mi fydd fy ngwraig i wrth ei bodd
delight is possessed in Welsh — wrth ei bodd, 'at her pleasure' — not predicated as an adjective

turns.en: I'm sure she will! The prescription's at your chemist within the hour.
turns.cy: Dw i'n siŵr y bydd hi! Mi fydd y presgripsiwn wrth eich fferyllydd chi o fewn yr awr.
chunks: Dw i'n siŵr y bydd hi!
English's stranded auxiliary has no Welsh reflex — the verb must be restated inside a y-clause
The prescription's at your chemist within the hour
Mi fydd y presgripsiwn wrth eich fferyllydd chi o fewn yr awr
English's clipped thanks converges with Diolch — reception, welcome

turns.en: A course of antibiotics - one twice a day, and finish the whole course even if you feel better.
turns.cy: Cwrs o wrthfiotigau — un ddwywaith y dydd, a gorffennwch y cwrs cyfan hyd yn oed os dach chi'n teimlo'n well.
chunks: and finish the whole course even if you feel better
a gorffennwch y cwrs cyfan hyd yn oed os dach chi'n teimlo'n well
⚠ line — the finish-the-course instruction, plainest possible

turns.en: Antibiotics upset my stomach terribly last time. Is there something else?
turns.cy: Mi wnaeth gwrthfiotigau ypsetio fy stumog i'n ofnadwy y tro dwytha. Oes 'na rywbeth arall?
chunks: Antibiotics upset my stomach terribly last time
Mi wnaeth gwrthfiotigau ypsetio fy stumog i'n ofnadwy y tro dwytha
⚠ line — English's bare past is ambiguous with the present; Welsh must choose, and the preterite is what the sentence means

turns.en: Take them with food, that protects the stomach. And if they still upset you, ring us rather than just stopping - stopping halfway is how infections come back stronger.
turns.cy: Cymrwch nhw efo bwyd — mae hynny'n gwarchod y stumog. Ac os ydyn nhw'n dal i'ch ypsetio chi, ffoniwch ni yn hytrach na jyst stopio — stopio hanner ffordd ydy sut mae heintiau'n dod yn ôl yn gryfach.
chunks: Take them with food, that protects the stomach
Cymrwch nhw efo bwyd — mae hynny'n gwarchod y stumog
And if they still upset you
Ac os ydyn nhw'n dal i'ch ypsetio chi
ring us rather than just stopping
ffoniwch ni yn hytrach na jyst stopio
⚠ line — the safety instruction, plainest possible
stopping halfway is how infections come back stronger
stopio hanner ffordd ydy sut mae heintiau'n dod yn ôl yn gryfach
⚠ line — identificatory fronting; the verbal noun subjects the clause where English uses a gerund

turns.en: Ring rather than stop. I'll admit, I just stopped them last time.
turns.cy: Ffonio yn hytrach na stopio. Mae'n rhaid i mi ddeud, mi wnes i jyst eu stopio nhw y tro dwytha.
chunks: ⚠ line — the imperative echoes as a verbal noun
'admit' relocates to the obligation frame — 'I must say'
I just stopped them last time
mi wnes i jyst eu stopio nhw y tro dwytha

turns.en: A lot of people do - it's the most natural thing when you feel better. But the full course, every time. Deal?
turns.cy: Mae 'na lot o bobl yn gneud — dyna'r peth mwya naturiol pan dach chi'n teimlo'n well. Ond y cwrs llawn, bob tro. Cytuno?
chunks: Mae 'na lot o bobl yn gneud
⚠ line — English's pro-verb 'do' has no Welsh reflex; the full verb returns
it's the most natural thing when you feel better
dyna'r peth mwya naturiol pan dach chi'n teimlo'n well
But the full course, every time
Ond y cwrs llawn, bob tro
⚠ line — English's noun becomes a Welsh verbal noun; there is no bargain-noun that would read here

turns.cy: Cytuno. Cwrs llawn, ar fy ngwir.
chunks: ⚠ line — English's scouting oath has no Welsh reflex; ar fy ngwir is the native oath-phrase
